remarks: Welcome to the Erika, a beautifully designed 1,653 sq. ft. home featuring 4 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and a versatile bonus room in the sought-after community of Kinglet by Big Lake. Thoughtfully designed for modern living, this home offers a spacious main floor complete with a bedroom and full bathroom, making it ideal for guests, multi-generational families, or a home office. The open-concept main living area is perfect for both everyday living and entertaining, featuring a stylish kitchen with a large central island, walk-in pantry, and seamless flow into the dining area and great room, highlighted by a cozy electric fireplace. Upstairs, you'll find three additional bedrooms, and a versatile bonus room. Ideally located near parks, walking trails, and the natural beauty of Big Lake, this community offers the perfect balance of nature and convenience. *Please note home is still under constructions, interior photos/upgrades may differ* (id:67522)
